title: Repair Android Vulkan correctness and exact workload capture
requires: Physical Pixel 7 Vulkan device and Android build/deployment toolchain
scope: Repair the non-timing Android Vulkan exit blockers recorded by F8-30: three lifecycle profiles fail at the first public step, four independent quality evaluations exceed frozen tolerances, all 30 public cases differ from the checked-in reference and the exact pixel7-gallery-v1 workload producer is missing. Preserve the sole schedule and shared Slang equations. Candidate-v10 remains immutable failed history.
acceptance: Reproduce and classify every F8-30 lifecycle, quality and public-reference failure on the physical Pixel 7 before repair; retain raw inputs, outputs and installed artifact identities.

Fix the public Vulkan resource, lifecycle, numerical or shared-kernel causes without weakening tolerances, changing workload counts, adding CPU physics fallback or introducing Android-specific equations.

Provide the installed public producer for all four exact pixel7-gallery-v1 workloads with 600 warmup and 7200 measured ticks, all samples and stalls retained, zero failed ticks and explicit timing/correctness separation.
Pass every advertised capability, applicable public case, physical scenario, quality profile, lifecycle/recovery assertion, independent work budget and negative control in plain and validation modes.
Pass Android Gallery catalog, controls, background/foreground, surface recreation, sustained-run and installed SDK checks. Publish exact source, APK, driver, device, OS and manifest hashes.
